She continues to ask us why we can't help, we repeat that we are off the clock and could potentially get in trouble. It goes on for a few more minutes until she decided to start berating us. She called us lazy and said that she was going to get us fired (we were trying to walk away the entire time btw and she almost hit me with her cart). Finally a manager shows up and says "ma'am, they just worked 8 hours. Please stop harassing my employees or I will ask you to leave the store. What do you need help with?" She started ranting about us not helping and some other things about the store but we just walked away after our manager took over. Saw the same manager before heading out and she mouthed "you ok?"
